root_cause.text: The `ieee80211_parse_adv_t2l` function in `net/mac80211/mlme.c` unconditionally reads a link mapping presence indicator byte from the TID-to-Link Mapping (TTLM) element without verifying the `IEEE80211_TTLM_CONTROL_DEF_LINK_MAP` flag, causing an out-of-bounds memory read when the default link map is indicated.
root_cause.evidence: The patch wraps the `link_map_presence = *pos; pos++;` statement in a conditional check `if (!(control & IEEE80211_TTLM_CONTROL_DEF_LINK_MAP))`, ensuring the byte is only read when the default link map flag is not set, addressing the CVE description stating the parser "would also read one byte beyond the end of the element."
